title: OpenVA Agent Enrichment Result
description: Host-neutral per-row enrichment result emitted by the MCP enrich_inventory tool and the match-service /v1/enrich endpoint. It records public-source references and machine-state notes only; it never carries a compliance, suitability, approval, or risk conclusion. additionalProperties is true so a transport may add a compatibility projection (e.g. the match service's spreadsheet block) without forking this contract.

row_id.description: The caller correlation id, echoed verbatim.

input.description: The bounded identity that was matched, echoed back.

sources.description: Canonical public sources for the matched vendor, filtered by requested type, preserving original vendor-published URLs. Empty unless the match status is matched.

primary_source_by_type.description: The primary source object per source_type, chosen deterministically by the shared ranking.

source_urls_by_type.description: Original source URLs grouped by source_type.

notes.description: Machine-state notes only (e.g. ambiguous match, no catalogue match, missing canonical source type). Never a compliance conclusion.

not_advice.description: Always true. OpenVA returns public-source references, not advice.

status.description: ambiguous is never collapsed into matched; a weak identity stays no_match.
